from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonetaryDetail(BaseModel):
    """Specific monetary amounts and who bears them mentioned in the judgment."""
    type: str | None = Field(description="What the amount refers to, e.g. '二审案件受理费'")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the amount")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who pays this amount, e.g. '上诉人', '被上诉人'")

class JudgmentEvidence(BaseModel):
    """Extracted evidence from a single judgment document for matching."""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The official case number, e.g., （2023）粤 0105 民初 18126 号")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the court that issued the judgment")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action, e.g., '法定继承纠纷'")
    appellants: list[str] = Field(description="Names of appellants")
    appellees: list[str] = Field(description="Names of appellees")
    ruling_type: str | None = Field(description="The main ruling decision, e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判', '撤销原判'")
    monetary_items: list[MonetaryDetail] = Field(description="List of monetary costs or payments")
    document_quote: str = Field(description="A key verbatim excerpt from the judgment")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[JudgmentEvidence]
